verdict.rationale: The changelog says the desktop app can install and run MCP connectors on your machine or local network. LobeHub also hosts a marketplace of roughly 100k MCP servers meant to power its Agents, so plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is a first-party capability. The evidence is only short changelog and marketing lines, and local MCP support is described as desktop-specific. Missing for 10: in-depth setup docs (transport types, remote/HTTP servers, web/self-hosted support), hands-on or independent corroboration that MCP tools work in agent runs.
